mcq_fix.s: Under the Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana as originally launched in 2017, which of the following combinations is correct?
mcq_fix.why: limits raised in 2018 to Rs 15 lakh / Rs 10,000 per month; stem must be dated

notes_fix.replace: Max Rs 7.5 lakh (2017 launch; raised to Rs 15 lakh in 2018)
notes_fix.why: PMVVY ceiling doubled to Rs 15 lakh in 2018

notes_fix.find: max purchase Rs 7.5 lakh, max pension Rs 5,000/month
notes_fix.replace: max purchase Rs 7.5 lakh, max pension Rs 5,000/month at launch (raised to Rs 15 lakh / Rs 10,000 in 2018)

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: Shyam Saran Negi was honoured as the first voter of independent India (option 4); also wrong topic: elections GK
wrong topic: health days / World AIDS Day

patterns: APPSC asks this topic as direct single facts: Act punishes children neglecting parents (APPSC 2018); Vayoshri launched at Nellore (APPSC G2 2017).
AP tilt: Nellore launch, RDO-headed Maintenance Tribunal, District Collector as Appellate Tribunal.
Important-days style items (1 October, 15 June) fit the APPSC 'days' pattern seen in filed PYQs.
Traps: scheme confusion PMVVY (pension) vs Ayushman Vay Vandana (health 70+) vs Vayoshri (aids).
App MCQs are mostly 3-statement items on scheme details; PYQs are simpler one-liners.
